== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
* New page from [https://web.archive.org/web/20030713191047/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/gencon05282003.htm SWCCG Player's Committee @ Gen Con 2003] (Internet Archive capture 13 July 2003): convention dates and venue, the nine Players Committee events with times, fees and prizes, the Young Jedi and Jedi Knights World Championship prize lists, and the 2002 Open Qualifier attendance. Also [https://web.archive.org/web/20030819162615/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/Archives/march03archives.htm March Updates (23 March 2003)] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20030809101318/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/News/Events/teamchampionship06122003.htm Team Championship Qualifiers Planned for 2003].
* '''Missing data:''' no results were found for any of the Players Committee events (Continentals, Young Jedi and Jedi Knights World Championships, side events, Team Tournament). The July 2003 archive page says there were no July news updates.
* '''Source discrepancy:''' the Gen Con 2003 announcement gives the Gen Con 2002 Open Qualifier as 64 players; [https://web.archive.org/web/20030613110815/http://swccgpc.com:80/News/duane2002yearend.htm The State Of SWCCG], Duane Bruun's 2002 year-end article, gives 54 (noted on [[List of SWCCG tournaments]]).
* Citation date 28 May 2003 follows the page's file name (gencon05282003) and the existing refs on [[Young Jedi]] and [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]].

== Old PC website (swccgpc.com) facts added, 24 November 2026 ==
* Sources (Players Committee forum): [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102222110/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=18922%26amp YJ Worlds] (post 18922, 5 March 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20041102222110/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=18922%26amp YJ Worlds] (post 29694, 20 June 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20041217215857/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=34439%26amp What strategies are mostly viable in classic?] (post 31335, 5 August 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20040928104229/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31154%26amp YJ World Championship Results?] (post 31042, 28 July 2003); [https://web.archive.org/web/20041105020948/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=31388%26amp Is the name of this year's YJ Champion a secret?] (post 31413, 8 August 2003).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Star Wars CCG Sealed Deck (Secret Squirrel) entry: $5 on the Players Committee's 28 May 2003 page, $10 in Jim Colson's 20 June 2003 forum schedule. The forum schedule also omits the Thursday Jedi Knights sealed and Friday Young Jedi sealed events.
=== Build notes ===
* "Damian" (winner of the Classic event, per Chris Wodicka, post 31335) is taken as [[Damian Loback]], who posted in the same thread just before (post 31309).
=== Missing data ===
* Results of the Continentals, Jedi Knights World Championship, sealed events and Team Tournament are still not sourced. Places 2–6 of the Young Jedi World Championship are not posted.
